Salary Range:
CHF146,300.00 - CHF271,700.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland or Cambridge, United States (see separate posting)

Ready to shape the future of innovation at Novartis? As a Patent Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in protecting groundbreaking scientific discoveries and enabling life-changing medicines to reach patients worldwide. Partnering closely with R&D teams, you will drive strategic intellectual property decisions, build robust patent portfolios, and navigate complex legal landscapes to safeguard innovation across the product lifecycle.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 146.300 - CHF 271.700

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters . Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

• Grado avanzato in chimica o campo correlato, con forte preferenza per un grado di dottorato

En tant qu'avocat en brevets, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la protection des découvertes scientifiques révolutionnaires et dans l'accès aux médicaments qui changent la vie des patients dans le monde entier. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de R-D, vous dirigerez les décisions stratégiques en matière de propriété intellectuelle, créerez de solides portefeuilles de brevets et naviguerez dans des paysages juridiques complexes pour préserver l'innovation tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités
• Fournir des conseils clairs, stratégiques et axés sur les affaires aux clients de la R-D de Novartis sur la protection des inventions, l'élaboration de portefeuilles, la stratégie de publication et les risques pour les tiers.

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF169,400.00 - CHF314,600.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: TA Head, PKS Immunology
Location: Basel

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary scientific leader to join us as TA Head, PK Sciences (PKS) Immunology. In this highly visible role, you will lead a cross-functional scientific organization spanning pharmacokinetics, clinical pharmacology, bioanalysis, and quantitative pharmacology across discovery, early development, and late-stage development. You will play a critical role in advancing the immunology portfolio, shaping integrated development strategies and enabling high-quality portfolio decisions.

As TA Head, PKS Immunology, you will provide strategic and scientific leadership across a portfolio of diverse modalities with a broad translational sciences remit. You will be responsible for defining fit-for-purpose development strategies across programs, ensuring scientific rigor in execution, and building strong partnerships across research, development, regulatory, and portfolio teams. This role requires a leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. You will also lead and develop scientists and serve as an important internal and external representative of the organization.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Define and implement integrated platform and program strategies from discovery through registration

• Support data-driven decision-making and differentiated development strategies for the immunology portfolio

• Oversee pharmacokinetic, clinical pharmacology, bioanalytical and quantitative pharmacology contributions to regulatory submissions and supporting documentation

• Support health authority interactions by ensuring high-quality scientific input into development and regulatory strategies

• Drive cross-functional collaboration across discovery, development, regulatory, and other key partner functions to ensure rigorous and efficient program execution

• Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing scientific team, including oversight of PKS Immunology scientists

• Serve as a scientific thought leader internally and externally through collaborations, publications, presentations, and participation in relevant scientific forums

• Promote operational excellence through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and effective use of resources

• Leverage digital tools, AI, and automation, where appropriate, to enhance insight generation, efficiency, and decision-making

Leadership Behaviors in Action

• Deliver results through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and a strong focus on value and outcomes

• Demonstrate an enterprise mindset and strong ownership by prioritizing resources and decisions for maximum portfolio and patient impact

• Role‑model leadership behaviors through visible actions, continuous self‑reflection, and openness to feedback

• Build trust through transparent communication, clear accountability, and consistent delivery against commitments

• Empower others to innovate and improve while maintaining high scientific, ethical, and operational standards

AI Fluency

• Bring strong AI and digital fluency, using enterprise tools to enhance insight generation, decision‑making, and team productivity

• Accountable for the ethical, transparent, and compliant use of AI in line with enterprise AI governance and data protection standards

External Eminence

#LI-Hybrid
Internal Title: Senior Principal Scientist or Associate Director
Location: Basel, Switzerland

The Modeling & Simulation group within PK Sciences is looking for a Principal Scientist to Associate Director level modeler, to develop and apply translational physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling along with data analysis techniques to facilitate drug discovery, development, and translational research across disease areas. Importantly, the candidate has experience with regulatory submissions and in successful regulatory interactions. The candidate’s core responsibilities will include PBPK modeling to integrate in vitro and in vivo data for drug-drug interaction (DDI) assessments, impact of biopharmaceutics properties on absorption, and pharmacokinetic (PK) predictions in humans as well as in specific populations (e.g. disease, organ impairment, pediatrics). The ultimate goal of this work is to be on the forefront of applying PBPK models to inform the safe administration of our drug candidates in the clinic, to optimize clinical trial designs, and waive clinical trials, ultimately, to get our medicines to patients faster.

The role requires a deep understanding of ADME/DMPK principles and biopharmaceutics knowledge, experience with industry standard PBPK modeling packages (such as GastroPlus or Simcyp) or bespoke PBPK models, regulatory submissions involving PBPK modeling, interdisciplinary thinking and great attention to detail. The applicant will work in a dynamic and multidisciplinary environment to build, verify and apply quality translational/biopharmaceutical PBPK models.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Expert PBPK modeler to provide translational modeling support for global drug discovery and development projects

• Perform translational PBPK analyses to predict clinical drug exposure in specific populations, assess potential for DDI, understand clinical impact of disease on drug exposure, as well as apply biopharmaceutic PBPK modeling to support formulation changes and achieve clinical biowaivers

• Integrate PK/ PD data, ADME and DDI findings

• Ability to interpret and communicate modeling results and potential impact to project teams

• Prepare summary documents for use in regulatory submissions and ability to respond independently to health authority questions

Essential requirements

• PhD in pharmaceutical sciences or related discipline with experience in ADME/DMPK sciences, biopharmaceutics, and modeling and simulation. At least 5+ years in pharmaceutical industry including demonstrated knowledge and experience with PBPK modeling. The level of the position would depend upon the experience of the candidate.

• Hands on experience with PBPK modeling tools such as PK-Sim, Simcyp, or GastroPlus is required. In addition, experience with modeling software such as Monolix, R, Phoenix, or Nonmem is desired.

• Experience in authoring regulatory documents, knowledge of global regulatory requirements and guidance

• Broad knowledge of drug discovery and development, e.g., pharmacokinetics, drug delivery, formulation, ADME, DDI, etc.

This is a hybrid role that requires a balance of in-person and virtual working, with an average of 12 days a month on site in Basel, Switzerland.
Candidates with demonstrated impact as a modeler, preferably in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, and with commensurate experience and proficiency may be considered for the Principal Scientist II (5+ years) or Associate Director (8+ years) role.

Qualifiche essenziali

The Oncology Data Science team in Biomedical Research at Novartis works at the intersection of oncology drug discovery, computational biology, AI/ML, and data engineering. We are seeking an enthusiastic AI/ML scientist with strong curiosity for AI-driven drug discovery to join the AI & Innovation team.
This role will apply advanced AI approaches to generate insights from complex multi-modal datasets and advance our target and biomarker discovery efforts.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Design, develop, implement and apply advanced machine learning algorithms, AI models, and platforms to enable the delivery of predictive insights from pre-clinical, clinical and real-world evidence datasets.

• Demonstrate value of innovative AI techniques in the context of drug target identification, biomolecular interaction modeling, drug development and biomarker discovery.

• Work with foundational models, including pre-trained, self-supervised, multi-purpose, and multi-modal models to advance generative AI applications in drug discovery.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and adopt best practices for ML-ready data.

• Contribute to scientific publications and present results at internal and external scientific conferences.

Requirements:

• Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Biology or related field.

• Practical experience across ML and LLM software stack, including feature engineering, model development, deployment, and validation.

• Prior experience working with omics data and familiarity with oncology drug development.

• Dimostra il valore delle tecniche AI innovative nel contesto dell'identificazione del bersaglio della droga, della modellazione dell'interazione biomolecolare, dello sviluppo della droga e della scoperta del biomarcatore.

• Lavorare con modelli di base, tra cui pre-trained, self-supervised, multi-purpose e modelli multi-modali per avanzare applicazioni AI generative nella scoperta della droga.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali per sviluppare e adottare le migliori pratiche per i dati ML-ready.

• Contribuire a pubblicazioni scientifiche e risultati attuali a conferenze scientifiche interne ed esterne.

Requisiti:

• Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Informatica, Matematica applicata, Biologia computazionale o campo relativo.

• Forte esperienza in una o più delle seguenti aree: AI generativo, modelli di fondazione biomedica, deep learning geometrico, apprendimento multi-modale e grafici di conoscenza su larga scala.

• Eccellente capacitÃ di programmazione e competenza in quadri di apprendimento profondi come PyTorch, con apertura all'apprendimento di nuovi strumenti e tecnologie.

• Esperienza pratica attraverso lo stack software ML e LLM, tra cui l'ingegneria delle caratteristiche, lo sviluppo del modello, la distribuzione e la validazione.

• Esperienza prima di lavorare con omics dati e familiarità con lo sviluppo di droga oncologia.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di comunicare intuizioni e raccomandazioni complesse ai team interfunzionali.

• Dimostrate forti competenze di ricerca, evidenziate da pubblicazioni nelle conferenze ML/AI e/o nelle principali riviste scientifiche.

• Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Informatik, Angewandte Mathematik, Computational Biology oder verwandten Bereich.

• Starke Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: generative KI, biomedizinische Grundlagenmodelle, geometrisches Deep Learning, multimodales Lernen und umfangreiche Wissensgraphen.

• Hervorragende Programmierkenntnisse und Kenntnisse in Deep-Learning-Frameworks wie PyTorch, mit Offenheit für das Erlernen neuer Tools und Technologien.

• Praktische Erfahrung im ML- und LLM-Software-Stack, einschließlich Feature Engineering, Modellentwicklung, Bereitstellung und Validierung.

• Vorherige Erfahrungen mit Omik-Daten und Vertrautheit mit der Entwicklung von Onkologie-Medikamenten.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Dateneinblicke und Empfehlungen an funktionsübergreifende Teams zu kommunizieren.

• Nachgewiesene starke Forschungskompetenzen, die durch Veröffentlichungen in hochrangigen ML/AI-Konferenzen und/oder führenden wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften belegt wurden.

Prämien
Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Medizin gemeinsam neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die sie ermöglichen.

Die Belohnungen, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über Grundlohn und Anreize hinaus. Wir bieten auch eine Vielzahl von Wettbewerbsvorteilen an, die Ihnen helfen, persönlich und professionell zu gedeihen, wie Versicherungspläne, Altersvorsorgepläne, Wohlbefindensressourcen und globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus bieten wir flexible und hybride Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wo möglich, und mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlten Elternurlaub.

Sur place

L'équipe Oncology Data Science de la recherche biomédicale de Novartis travaille à l'intersection de la découverte de médicaments en oncologie, de la biologie computationnelle, de l'IA/ML et du génie des données. Nous recherchons un scientifique enthousiaste de l'IA/ML avec une forte curiosité pour la découverte de médicaments de l'IA pour rejoindre l'équipe de l'IA & Innovation.
Ce rôle appliquera des approches d'IA avancées pour générer des idées à partir de ensembles de données multimodal complexes et faire progresser nos efforts de découverte de cibles et de biomarqueurs.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et appliquer des algorithmes avancés d'apprentissage automatique, des modèles d'IA et des plates-formes afin de permettre la diffusion de données précliniques, cliniques et factuelles.

• Démontrer la valeur des techniques innovatrices d'IA dans le contexte de l'identification des cibles de médicaments, de la modélisation de l'interaction biomoléculaire, du développement de médicaments et de la découverte de biomarqueurs.

• Travailler avec des modèles fondamentaux, y compris des modèles pré-entrainés, auto-supervisés, polyvalents et multimodaux pour faire progresser les applications d'IA génératives dans la découverte de médicaments.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles afin d'élaborer et d'adopter des pratiques exemplaires pour les données prêtes à l'emploi.

• Contribuer aux publications scientifiques et présenter les résultats lors de conférences scientifiques internes et externes.

Exigences:

• Doctorat en apprentissage automatique, informatique, mathématiques appliquées, biologie informatique ou domaine connexe.

• Forte expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : IA générative, modèles de fondation biomédicale, apprentissage géométrique profond, apprentissage multimodal et graphiques de connaissances à grande échelle.

• Excellentes compétences en programmation et compétences dans les cadres d'apprentissage profond comme PyTorch, avec ouverture à l'apprentissage de nouveaux outils et technologies.

• Expérience pratique dans la pile de logiciels ML et LLM, y compris l'ingénierie des fonctionnalités, le développement de modèles, le déploiement et la validation.

• Expérience antérieure de travail avec les données omiques et connaissance du développement de médicaments oncologiques.

• Excellentes compétences en communication, avec la capacité de communiquer des données complexes et des recommandations aux équipes interfonctionnelles.

• Fortes compétences en recherche démontrées, mises en évidence par des publications dans des conférences ML/AI de haut niveau ou des revues scientifiques de premier plan.

Job Description

Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Supported.

At Novartis, our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people's lives. As Disease Area Lead, Immunology, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the commercial success of our Immunology portfolio across Europe.

You will partner closely with country commercial teams, Medical, Value & Access, and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive performance, enhance launch excellence, and build capabilities across the region.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive regional performance through market insight analysis, identification of growth opportunities, and implementation of high-impact actions across priority markets.

• Partner with country teams to optimize portfolio performance while preparing markets for future growth opportunities and innovations.

• Lead launch readiness planning and execution, ensuring successful delivery of pre-launch and post-launch milestones.

• Drive commercial excellence through data-driven decision making, customer engagement optimization, segmentation, targeting, and omnichannel effectiveness.

• Collaborate closely with Medical, Value & Access, Regulatory, and Execution Excellence functions to deliver integrated business outcomes.

• Share best practices and build capabilities across markets, fostering a high-performance culture and strengthening Immunology expertise throughout the region.

• Influence and align stakeholders across a complex matrix organization while driving accountability for execution and results.

• Monitor competitive dynamics and healthcare market trends to inform strategic decisions and strengthen market preparedness.

Essential Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business, Marketing, or a related field.

• Significant experience in the pharmaceutical industry with a strong commercial background.

• Proven leadership experience at country level, such as Therapeutic Area Head, Marketing & Sales Head, Commercial Portfolio Lead, or equivalent commercial leadership role.

• Strong track record of developing and executing brand strategies that deliver measurable business impact.

• Experience leading or supporting product launches and lifecycle management within complex healthcare environments.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret market, performance, customer, and financial data to drive strategic decisions.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Commercial Excellence teams.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, including the ability to lead through influence across matrix organizations.

• Experience working in regional and/or international environments with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

• Fluent English communication skills.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working across multiple European markets with a strong understanding of regional healthcare systems and market dynamics.

• Prior Immunology commercial leadership experience, including responsibility for biologics and/or specialty care portfolios.

• Experience driving launch excellence in innovative specialty medicines.

• Advanced understanding of customer engagement, omnichannel strategy, and commercial analytics.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 154,700.00 - 287,300.00 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams’ representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

Are you ready to shape the quality strategy behind some of the world's most innovative medicines? As Global Head CQA Development Unit, you will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of clinical development, patient safety, and regulatory excellence. Leading a global team of Clinical Quality professionals, you will drive strategic quality oversight across complex development programs, enabling quality-by-design approaches that accelerate innovation while safeguarding compliance, data integrity, and patient well-being. This is a unique opportunity to influence critical business decisions, partner with senior leaders across Novartis, and help bring transformative treatments to patients worldwide.

Job Description
Key responsibilities:

• Lead and develop a global team of Clinical Quality Program Leads, fostering a high-performance quality culture.

• Define and execute the quality strategy for assigned Development Units, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

• Provide strategic quality oversight across clinical development programs to support regulatory success and patient safety.

• Partner with senior stakeholders to identify, mitigate, and escalate quality risks across global studies.

• Champion inspection readiness and lead quality support for regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen compliance, operational excellence, and quality-by-design principles.

• Influence organizational quality mindset by embedding proactive risk management and quality governance practices.

Essential Requirements:

• Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline.

• Extensive experience in clinical development, quality assurance, pharmacovigilance, or regulated healthcare environments.

• Proven leadership experience building, developing, and leading global teams within a complex matrix organization.

• Deep understanding of end-to-end clinical trial processes and global regulatory requirements for clinical research.

• Demonstrated success managing high-complexity programs and influencing senior stakeholders across functions.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive collaboration globally.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 133,700.00 - 248,300.00 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.
The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams’ representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. #LI-Hybrid #
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera

Sei pronto a plasmare la strategia di qualità dietro alcune delle medicine più innovative del mondo? Come Global Head CQA Development Unit, svolgerai un ruolo di leadership fondamentale nell'intersezione dello sviluppo clinico, della sicurezza dei pazienti e dell'eccellenza normativa. Conducendo un team globale di professionisti della qualità clinica, si guida la supervisione strategica della qualità attraverso programmi di sviluppo complessi, consentendo approcci di qualità per design che accelerano l'innovazione, salvaguardando la conformità, l'integrità dei dati e il benessere dei pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per influenzare le decisioni aziendali critiche, partner con leader senior in Novartis, e contribuire a portare trattamenti trasformativi a pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Descrizione del lavoro
Responsabilità chiave:

• Guidare e sviluppare un team globale di Leader del Programma di Qualità Clinica, promuovendo una cultura di qualità ad alte prestazioni.

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia di qualità per le unità di sviluppo assegnate, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Fornire una supervisione strategica della qualità attraverso i programmi di sviluppo clinico per supportare il successo normativo e la sicurezza dei pazienti.

• Partner con gli stakeholder senior per identificare, mitigare e aumentare i rischi di qualità negli studi globali.

• Prontezza di ispezione campione e supporto di qualità di piombo per le ispezioni di regolazione, audit e attività di bonifica.

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo che rafforzino la conformità, l'eccellenza operativa e i principi di qualità-by-design.

• Influenza mentalità organizzativa di qualità incorporando pratiche proattive di gestione del rischio e di governance della qualità.

Requisiti essenziali:

• Laurea avanzata in Scienze della Vita, Medicina, Farmacia, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.

• Ampia esperienza di sviluppo clinico, garanzia di qualità, farmacovigilanza, o ambienti sanitari regolamentati.

• Prove esperienze di leadership costruire, sviluppare e leader team globali all'interno di una complessa organizzazione matrice.

• Profonda comprensione dei processi di sperimentazione clinica end-to-end e dei requisiti normativi globali per la ricerca clinica.

• Dimostrato successo gestione di programmi ad alta complessità e influenzare gli stakeholder senior attraverso le funzioni.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving con la capacità di guidare la collaborazione a livello globale.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: 133,700.00 - 248,300.00 CHF

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.
Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

I premi azionari a lungo termine concessi a livello di gruppo possono anche essere parte del vostro pacchetto. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di applicazione.

Job Description Summary
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) is the innovation engine of Novartis that collaborates across the company and beyond, focusing on powerful new technologies that have the potential to help produce therapeutic breakthroughs for patients. Translational Medicine (TM) is the clinical research arm of Novartis BR, and includes about 900 associates globally. TM plays a pivotal role in bringing innovative medicines to patients, by building on research advances to develop new therapies, and bridging drug discovery and clinical application.
The TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) is a group of physicians and clinical researchers who drive innovative science from discovery to the patient through the selection, profiling, and effective development of medicines. Translational medicine experts oversee Phase 1 and 2 clinical trials to demonstrate proof-of-mechanism and proof-of-concept (PoC) in patients, as well as support for later Phase 3 development. Translational medicine experts are key and highly visible members of global cross-functional project teams that design and implement early research and discovery projects, that then culminate in clinical PoC studies. Translational medicine experts collaborate with colleagues in biology and chemistry to identify targets in diseases with significant unmet medical needs and provide input on likely clinical development pathways. The early clinical trials led by our translational medicine experts are among the most critical steps in drug development at Novartis. After PoC and if the program proceeds to full development, the translational medicine expert continues as a key member of the full development team up to and including registration.
As a Cardiovascular Metabolism (CVM) TM Expert, you will collaborate with the CVM TM Head or other experienced TM Experts to develop high value decision-strategies for the Translational Medicine component of drug development projects and to lead global cross-functional project teams through the PoC phase and beyond.

Job Description
# LI- hybrid

TME Director Cardiovascular Metabolism

Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of clinical trials research, data collection activities and clinical operations, serving a leadership role in the matrixed trial team. Establishes and approves scientific methods for design and implementation of clinical protocols, data collection systems and final reports. Support new and ongoing clinical research and clinical trials and ensure efficient and timely processing of confidentiality agreements and clinical agreements

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead global project teams through PoC phase to drive implementation of the PoC strategy; participate in project teams through program life cycle from NTRC to registration

• Responsible for clinical portions of the Integrated Development Plan (IDP) through PoC.

• Acts as medical monitor for one or more clinical studies.

• Communicate clinical team matters to project teams and relevant decision boards (such as the Disease Area Decision Board).

• Convene relevant (internal and external) leaders to consider proposed approach to PoC.

• Evaluate clinical centers and foster communication with crucial collaborating investigators.

• Oversee publication and external presentation of PoC clinical study results.

• Accountable for compound related biomarker strategies; work closely with biomarker experts in implementation.

• In collaboration with research scientists identify, develop and implement strategy for preclinical support of program related objectives; this includes assessment of medical need, proposal of clinical development pathways, and review of preclinical data for clinical implications and other relevant activities

• Participate in team presentations to Health Authorities as TM Expert

Essential Requirements:

• Doctoral degree, MD required with clinical subspecialty training preferred in cardiovascular disease or endocrinology/metabolic disease; Additional PhD/post-doctoral equivalent research preferred.

• At least 1-2 years’ experience in a pharmaceutical/biotech company, CRO, or academic medical center, or related experience; 5 plus years to be considered for Director level.

• Recognized for medical expertise.

• Recognized for scientific expertise and passion for science: respected by colleagues internally and externally, having made significant contributions to the field and created / established new concepts; record of high quality publications in international scientific journals.

• Excellent written and oral communication/presentation skills.

• Independence: Able to work independently on study planning and execution, and with supervision on project planning.

• Leadership of Collaborations: Able to lead multidisciplinary teams in a matrix organization.

• Innovation: Seeks out new clinical discovery opportunities and PoC approaches.

• Additional consideration for candidates with advanced research experience in data science, genetics/genomics, artificial intelligence applied to clinical research, or digital/wearable health science.

Descrizione del lavoro
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) è il motore di innovazione di Novartis che collabora in tutta l'azienda e oltre, concentrandosi su potenti nuove tecnologie che hanno il potenziale di contribuire a produrre scoperte terapeutiche per i pazienti. Translational Medicine (TM) è il braccio di ricerca clinico di Novartis BR, e comprende circa 900 associati a livello globale. TM svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel portare farmaci innovativi ai pazienti, costruendo sui progressi della ricerca per sviluppare nuove terapie, e corrompere la scoperta della droga e l'applicazione clinica.
TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) è un gruppo di medici e ricercatori clinici che guidano la scienza innovativa dalla scoperta al paziente attraverso la selezione, la profilazione e lo sviluppo efficace dei farmaci. Esperti di medicina traduttiva supervisionano la fase 1 e 2 sperimentazioni cliniche per dimostrare la prova del meccanismo e la prova del concetto (PoC) nei pazienti, nonché il supporto per lo sviluppo successivo della fase 3. Esperti di medicina traduttiva sono membri chiave e altamente visibili di team di progetto interfunzionali globali che progettano e implementano i primi progetti di ricerca e scoperta, che poi culminano negli studi clinici del PoC. Esperti di medicina traduttiva collaborano con i colleghi in biologia e chimica per identificare gli obiettivi nelle malattie con significative esigenze mediche non misurate e fornire input su probabili percorsi di sviluppo clinico. I primi studi clinici condotti dai nostri esperti di medicina traduttiva sono tra i passi più critici nello sviluppo della droga a Novartis. Dopo PoC e se il programma procede a pieno sviluppo, l'esperto di medicina traduttiva continua come membro chiave del team di sviluppo completo fino a e compresa la registrazione.
Come esperto di Metabolismo cardiovascolare (CVM) TM, collaborerai con il CVM TM Head o altri esperti TM per sviluppare strategie decisionali ad alto valore per la componente di Medicina Traduzionale dei progetti di sviluppo della droga e per condurre team di progetto multifunzionali globali attraverso la fase PoC e oltre.

Descrizione del lavoro
# LI- ibrido

TME Direttore Metabolismo cardiovascolare

Supera la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e l'interpretazione della ricerca di studi clinici, le attività di raccolta dati e le operazioni cliniche, servendo un ruolo di leadership nel team di prova matrice. Stabilisce e approva metodi scientifici per la progettazione e l'attuazione di protocolli clinici, sistemi di raccolta dati e relazioni finali. Sostenere la ricerca clinica e le sperimentazioni cliniche in corso e garantire un trattamento efficiente e tempestivo degli accordi di riservatezza e degli accordi clinici

Responsabilità chiave:

• Leader team di progetto globali attraverso la fase PoC per guidare l'implementazione della strategia PoC; partecipare a team di progetto attraverso il ciclo di vita del programma da NTRC a registrazione

• Responsabile per le porzioni cliniche del Piano di Sviluppo Integrato (IDP) tramite PoC.

• Agisce come monitor medico per uno o più studi clinici.

• Comunicare le questioni del team clinico per i team di progetto e i comitati decisionali rilevanti (come il Consiglio di decisione Area Malattia).

• Convocare i leader rilevanti (interni ed esterni) per considerare l'approccio proposto al PoC.

• Valutare i centri clinici e promuovere la comunicazione con gli investigatori di collaborazione cruciali.

• Superare la pubblicazione e la presentazione esterna dei risultati dello studio clinico PoC.

• Contabile per le strategie di biomarcatore relative a composti; lavorare a stretto contatto con gli esperti di biomarcatori in attuazione.

• In collaborazione con gli scienziati di ricerca identificare, sviluppare e attuare la strategia per il supporto preclinico degli obiettivi relativi al programma; ciò include la valutazione delle necessità mediche, la proposta di percorsi di sviluppo clinico e la revisione dei dati preclinici per le implicazioni cliniche e altre attività rilevanti

• Partecipa a presentazioni di team alle autorità sanitarie come TM Expert

Requisiti essenziali:

• Grado di dottorato, MD richiesto con formazione di subspecialità clinica preferito nel cardiovascolare

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) ist der Innovationsmotor von Novartis, der unternehmensweit und darüber hinaus zusammenarbeitet und sich auf leistungsstarke neue Technologien konzentriert, die das Potenzial haben, therapeutische Durchbrüche für Patienten zu erzielen. Translational Medicine (TM) ist der klinische Forschungszweig von Novartis BR und umfasst weltweit rund 900 Mitarbeiter. TM spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Bereitstellung innovativer Medikamente für Patienten, indem es auf den Forschungsfortschritten zur Entwicklung neuer Therapien aufbaut und die Wirkstoffforschung und klinische Anwendung verbindet.
Das TM Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) ist eine Gruppe von Ärzten und klinischen Forschern, die innovative Wissenschaft von der Entdeckung bis zum Patienten durch die Auswahl, Profilierung und effektive Entwicklung von Medikamenten vorantreiben. Translationale Medizin-Experten beaufsichtigen klinische Studien der Phase 1 und 2, um den Nachweis von Mechanik und Proof-of-Concept (PoC) bei Patienten sowie die Unterstützung für die spätere Entwicklung der Phase 3 zu demonstrieren. Translationale Medizin-Experten sind wichtige und gut sichtbare Mitglieder der globalen cross-funktionalen Projekt-teams, die design und Umsetzung der frühen Forschung und discovery-Projekte, die dann gipfeln in klinischen PoC-Studien. Experten für Translationale Medizin arbeiten mit Kollegen aus Biologie und Chemie zusammen, um Ziele bei Krankheiten mit erheblichen ungedeckten medizinischen Bedürfnissen zu identifizieren und Input zu wahrscheinlichen klinischen Entwicklungspfaden zu liefern. Die frühen klinischen Studien, die von unseren Experten für translationale Medizin geleitet werden, gehören zu den wichtigsten Schritten in der Arzneimittelentwicklung bei Novartis. Nach dem PoC und wenn das Programm zur vollständigen Entwicklung übergeht, bleibt der Experte für translationale Medizin bis zur Registrierung als wichtiges Mitglied des gesamten Entwicklungsteams tätig.
Als Experte für Herz-Kreislauf-Metabolismen (CVM) TM arbeiten Sie mit dem CVM TM-Leiter oder anderen erfahrenen TM-Experten zusammen, um hochwertige Entscheidungsstrategien für die Translational Medicine-Komponente von Medikamentenentwicklungsprojekten zu entwickeln und globale funktionsübergreifende Projektteams durch die PoC-Phase und darüber hinaus zu führen.

Stellenbeschreibung
# LI-Hybrid

TME-Direktor Herz-Kreislauf-Metabolismus

Beaufsichtigt die Planung, Durchführung und Interpretation der klinischen Studienforschung, Datenerfassungsaktivitäten und klinischen Operationen und übernimmt eine Führungsrolle im matrixisierten Studienteam. Etabliert und genehmigt wissenschaftliche Methoden für die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von klinischen Protokollen, Datenerfassungssystemen und Abschlussberichten. Unterstützung neuer und laufender klinischer Forschung und klinischer Studien und Gewährleistung einer effizienten und zeitnahen Verarbeitung von Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarungen und klinischen Vereinbarungen

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Führen Sie globale Projektteams durch die PoC-Phase, um die Umsetzung der PoC-Strategie voranzutreiben; beteiligen Sie sich an Projektteams durch den Programmlebenszyklus von NTRC bis zur Registrierung

• Verantwortlich für klinische Teile des Integrated Development Plan (IDP) durch PoC.

• Funktioniert als medizinischer Monitor für eine oder mehrere klinische Studien.

• Kommunizieren Sie klinische Teamangelegenheiten an Projektteams und relevante Entscheidungsgremien (wie das Disease Area Decision Board).

• Treffen Sie relevante (interne und externe) Führungskräfte, um den vorgeschlagenen Ansatz für PoC zu prüfen.

• Bewerten Sie klinische Zentren und fördern Sie die Kommunikation mit wichtigen kooperierenden Ermittlern.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Veröffentlichung und externe Präsentation der Ergebnisse der klinischen PoC-Studie.

• Verantwortlich für verbindungsbezogene Biomarker-Strategien; eng mit Biomarker-Experten bei der Umsetzung zusammenarbeiten.

• In Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungswissenschaftlern identifizieren, entwickeln und implementieren Sie eine Strategie für die präklinische Unterstützung programmbezogener Ziele; dazu gehören die Bewertung des medizinischen Bedarfs, der Vorschlag klinischer Entwicklungspfade und die Überprüfung präklinischer Daten für klinische Implikationen und andere relevante Aktivitäten

• Nehmen Sie an Teampräsentationen vor Gesundheitsbehörden als TM-Experte teil

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

• Doktorgrad, MD erforderlich mit klinischen Subspezialisierung Ausbildung bevorzugt in kardiovaskulären

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
Novartis BioMedical Research (BR) est le moteur d'innovation de Novartis qui collabore à travers l'entreprise et au-delà, en mettant l'accent sur les nouvelles technologies puissantes qui ont le potentiel d'aider à produire des percées thérapeutiques pour les patients. La médecine translationnelle (MC) est le bras de recherche clinique de Novartis BR et comprend environ 900 associés dans le monde. TM joue un rôle central dans l'apport de médicaments innovants aux patients, en s'appuyant sur les progrès de la recherche pour développer de nouvelles thérapies, et en reliant la découverte de médicaments et l'application clinique.
Le MC Discovery & Profiling (TMDP) est un groupe de médecins et de chercheurs cliniques qui conduisent la science innovante de la découverte au patient par la sélection, le profilage et le développement efficace des médicaments. Les experts en médecine translationnelle supervisent les essais cliniques des phases 1 et 2 afin de démontrer l'existence d'une preuve de mécanisation et d'une preuve de conception chez les patients, ainsi que le soutien au développement ultérieur de la phase 3. Les experts en médecine translationnelle sont des membres clés et très visibles d'équipes mondiales de projets interfonctionnels qui conçoivent et mettent en œuvre des projets de recherche et de découverte précoces, qui culminent ensuite dans des études cliniques du PdC. Les experts en médecine translationnelle collaborent avec des collègues en biologie et en chimie pour identifier des cibles dans des maladies ayant des besoins médicaux non satisfaits importants et fournir des commentaires sur les voies de développement clinique probables. Les premiers essais cliniques menés par nos experts en médecine translationnelle comptent parmi les étapes les plus critiques du développement des médicaments à Novartis. Après le PAC et si le programme progresse jusqu'au développement complet, l'expert en médecine translationnelle continue d'être un membre clé de l'équipe de développement complet jusqu'à l'inscription.
En tant qu'expert en métabolisme cardio-vasculaire (CVM), vous collaborerez avec le chef du CVM TM ou d'autres experts en gestion des médicaments expérimentés afin d'élaborer des stratégies de décision de grande valeur pour la composante Médecine translationnelle des projets de développement de médicaments et de diriger des équipes mondiales de projets interfonctionnels au cours de la phase du PMC et au-delà.

Description de l'emploi
# hybride LI

TME Directeur Métabolisme cardiovasculaire

Supervise la planification, l'exécution et l'interprétation de la recherche sur les essais cliniques, des activités de collecte de données et des opérations cliniques, servant de chef de file dans l'équipe d'essais matricielle. Établir et approuver des méthodes scientifiques pour la conception et la mise en oeuvre de protocoles cliniques, de systèmes de collecte de données et de rapports finaux. Soutenir la recherche clinique et les essais cliniques nouveaux et en cours et assurer le traitement efficace et en temps opportun des ententes de confidentialité et des ententes cliniques

Principales responsabilités :

• Diriger les équipes de projet à l'échelle mondiale jusqu'à la phase du Programme de coordination des projets pour diriger la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie du Programme de coordination des projets; participer aux équipes de projet pendant le cycle de vie des programmes, du CRTN à l'inscription.

• Responsable des volets cliniques du Plan de développement intégré (PDI) par l'entremise du PdC.

• Agir comme moniteur médical pour une ou plusieurs études cliniques.

• Communiquer les questions de l'équipe clinique aux équipes de projet et aux comités de décision pertinents (comme le comité de décision de la région de la maladie).

• Convoquer les dirigeants pertinents (internes et externes) pour examiner l'approche proposée à l'égard du PA.

• Évaluer les centres cliniques et favoriser la communication avec les chercheurs partenaires cruciaux.

• Superviser la publication et la présentation externe des résultats de l'étude clinique du PoC.

• Responsable des stratégies de biomarqueurs liées aux composés; travailler en étroite collaboration avec des experts en biomarqueurs dans la mise en oeuvre.

• En collaboration avec des chercheurs scientifiques, définir, élaborer et mettre en oeuvre une stratégie d'appui préclinique aux objectifs du programme, y compris l'évaluation des besoins médicaux, la proposition de voies de développement clinique et l'examen des données précliniques sur les répercussions cliniques et d'autres activités pertinentes.

• Participer à des présentations d'équipes aux autorités de la santé en tant qu'expert en gestion de la santé

Exigences essentielles:

• Doctorat, MD requis avec une formation clinique de sous-spécialité préférée en cardiologie

Bringing life-changing medicines to millions of people, Novartis sits at the intersection of cutting-edge medical science and innovative digital technology. Biomarkers are critical components of translational research, enabling robust therapeutic and mechanistic hypothesis testing in early clinical development, and as precision medicine enablers e.g. defining patient subpopulations, predicting patient responses, and use as diagnostics.
The Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Translational Medicine, partners with other Disease area, Translational Medicine, Global Development, and Commercial leadership for the development and implementation of innovative, complex, exploratory biomarker strategies, independent of clinical program stage, and provides an effective interface for transitioning projects to later stage development. The BMD TABH leads and develops a dedicated group of biomarker project team leads (BML) and therapeutic area biomarker leads (TABL) to develop and oversee clinical project strategies, plans and timelines

• Key leader to identify, develop, and drive disease, mechanistic biology, translational pharmacology and precision medicine approaches for the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio, leveraging diverse biomarker modalities e.g. genetics, genomics, proteins, cells, imaging, digital devices and technology/data science strategies

The Therapeutic Area Head (TABH) in Biomarker Development (BMD) in Translational Medicine, partners with other Disease area, Translational Medicine, Global Development, and Commercial leadership for the development and implementation of innovative, complex, exploratory biomarker strategies, independent of clinical program stage, and provides an effective interface for transitioning projects to later stage development. The BMD TABH leads and develops a dedicated group of biomarker project team leads (BML) and therapeutic area biomarker leads (TABL) to develop and oversee clinical project strategies, plans and timelines

Key Responsibilities:

• Key leader to identify, develop, and drive disease, mechanistic biology, translational pharmacology and precision medicine approaches for the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio, leveraging diverse biomarker modalities e.g. genetics, genomics, proteins, cells, imaging, digital devices and technology/data science strategies

• Strategic decision-making and executive oversight in indication / patient selection, biomarker strategy formulation, and investigations into drug mechanisms of action

• Responsible for delivering clinical project and disease biology “fit for purpose” biomarker strategies/plans across the Neuroscience and DARe (Diseases of Aging and Regenerative medicine) portfolio and leading reviews at Disease Area Decision Boards (DADBs), Biomarker Forum, Biomarker and Diagnostic Review Committee, TDSCs and governance boards

jobs.description:

CHF93,800.00 - CHF174,200.00

Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite

Role Purpose:
At Novartis, we are reimagining medicine to improve and extend people's lives. We discover and develop breakthrough treatments and find new ways to bring cures to as many people as possible. Without safe, easy-to-use, high-quality drug delivery devices, our patients could not get their medicines. This is where you come in - the Device Technology Solution Center is looking for a Senior Expert Engineering to lead the development of innovative drug-device combination products.

We from the Device Technology Solution Center drives the technical development of autoinjectors as well as novel drug delivery principles, e.g. on-body injectors, inhalers or radioligand therapy. We closely collaborate with project management, human factors engineers, packaging experts, analytical testing, quality assurance, production, external partners, regulatory experts and many more. The objective is to develop and/or integrate innovative drug delivery systems with drug formulation and author state-of-the-art technical documentation for health authorities and production.

Job Description
Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Provide technical leadership in cross-functional device development subteams for autoinjector and other drug-device combination product development projects

• Define design input requirements and specifications, and author, review, and approve Design History File (DHF) documentation

• Lead design verification and characterization activities to demonstrate compliance with applicable requirements, standards, and intended use

• Provide technical input to regulatory submission dossiers and support responses to health authority questions related to device design, performance, and verification activities.

• Perform technical investigations and root cause analyses, identify corrective actions, and implement robust technical solutions to prevent recurrence of product and process issues.

• Ensure development activities comply with applicable regulations, standards, and internal procedures

• Collaborate with external partners, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and internal manufacturing organizations to ensure successful device development and industrialization.

• Ensure documentation and materials are delivered to support clinical studies, registration, and commercial manufacturing.

• Provide scientific and technical guidance to team members, facilitate knowledge sharing, and contribute to the development of engineering best practices.

Role Requirements

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline

• Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in medical device and/or combination product development

• Excellent verbal communication and technical writing skills in English are required

• Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and lead technical initiatives in a matrix environment.

• Experience in design verification

• Good knowledge of applicable medical device regulations and industry standards

• Experience working with suppliers and CMOs

• Experience with Design Controls and Design History File (DHF) documentation

• Minimum 80% on site work (4 days/week)

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 93,800 to CHF174,200

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Descrizione del Lavoro Riassunto Ubicazione: Basel, Svizzera #onsite

Scopo del ruolo: In Novartis, stiamo reimmaginando la medicina per migliorare e prolungare la vita delle persone. Scopriamo e sviluppiamo trattamenti innovativi e troviamo nuovi modi per portare cure a quante più persone possibile. Senza dispositivi di consegna di droga sicuri, facili da usare e di alta qualità, i nostri pazienti non hanno potuto ottenere i loro farmaci. Qui è dove si entra - Device Technology Solution Center è alla ricerca di un Senior Expert Engineering per guidare lo sviluppo di innovativi prodotti di combinazione di dispositivi per droga.

Noi del Device Technology Solution Center guidiamo lo sviluppo tecnico degli autoiniettori e dei nuovi principi di distribuzione della droga, ad esempio iniettori sul corpo, inalatori o radioterapia. Collaboriamo strettamente con la gestione dei progetti, ingegneri dei fattori umani, esperti di packaging, test analitici, garanzia della qualità, produzione, partner esterni, esperti di regolamentazione e molti altri. L'obiettivo è quello di sviluppare e/o integrare sistemi innovativi di consegna della droga con la formulazione di farmaci e la documentazione tecnica all'avanguardia degli autori per le autorità sanitarie e la produzione.

Descrizione del lavoro Le tue responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Fornire la leadership tecnica nello sviluppo di apparecchiature interfunzionali sottoteam per i progetti di sviluppo di prodotti combinati con dispositivi antidroga e autoiniettori

• Definire requisiti e specifiche di input di progettazione, e autore, revisione, e approvare la documentazione di Design History File (DHF)

• Attività di verifica e caratterizzazione del progetto di piombo per dimostrare la conformità ai requisiti, agli standard e all'uso previsto applicabili

• fornire contributi tecnici ai fascicoli di presentazione delle normative e fornire risposte di supporto alle domande delle autorità sanitarie relative alla progettazione, alle prestazioni e alle attività di verifica dei dispositivi.

• Eseguire indagini tecniche e analisi delle cause profonde, identificare azioni correttive e implementare soluzioni tecniche robuste per prevenire la ricorrenza di problemi di prodotto e processo.

• Garantire che le attività di sviluppo siano conformi alle normative, agli standard e alle procedure interne applicabili

• Collaborazione con partner esterni, fornitori, produttori di contratti e organizzazioni di produzione interna per garantire lo sviluppo e l'industrializzazione di dispositivi di successo.

• Assicurarsi che la documentazione e i materiali siano forniti a supporto degli studi clinici, della registrazione e della produzione commerciale.

• fornire orientamenti scientifici e tecnici ai membri del gruppo, facilitare la condivisione delle conoscenze e contribuire allo sviluppo delle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche.

Requisiti di ruolo

• Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Biomedica o disciplina correlata

• Esperienza significativa (tipicamente 10+ anni) nello sviluppo di dispositivi medici e/o prodotti combinati

• Ottima comunicazione verbale e capacità di scrittura tecnica in inglese sono necessarie

• Capacità dimostrativa di influenzare i team interfunzionali e di condurre iniziative tecniche in un ambiente matrice.

• Esperienza nella verifica del progetto

• Buona conoscenza delle normative applicabili sui dispositivi medici e degli standard industriali

• Esperienza di lavoro con fornitori e CMO

• Esperienza con la documentazione dei controlli di progettazione e della storia del progetto (DHF)

• Minimo 80% sul lavoro in loco (4 giorni/settimana)

Impegno alla diversità e inclusione:

La Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale e inclusivo e diversi team di rappresentanti dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci siamo impegnati a reimmaginare la medicina insieme - e a ricompensare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Gamma annuale di base prevista per il ruolo: CHF 93,800 a CHF 174,200

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi neutrali per il genere, quali competenze, competenze ed esperienza pertinenti in conformità della politica di determinazione delle retribuzioni della Novartis e una volta entrato a far parte della Novartis sarà rivisto periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, puoi essere idoneo

Role Purpose: Bei Novartis entwickeln wir Medikamente, um das Leben der Menschen zu verbessern und zu verlängern. Wir entdecken und entwickeln bahnbrechende Behandlungen und finden neue Wege, um so viele Menschen wie möglich mit Heilung zu versorgen. Ohne sichere, einfach zu bedienende, hochwertige Arzneimittelliefermittel konnten unsere Patienten ihre Medikamente nicht bekommen. Hier kommen Sie ins Spiel - das Device Technology Solution Center sucht ein Senior Expert Engineering, um die Entwicklung innovativer Arzneimittelkombinationsprodukte zu leiten.

Wir vom Device Technology Solution Center treiben die technische Entwicklung von Autoinjektoren sowie neuartige Arzneimittelauslieferungsprinzipien, z.B. On-body-Injektoren, Inhalatoren oder Radioligand-Therapie, voran. Wir arbeiten eng mit Projektmanagement, Humanfaktoren-Ingenieuren, Verpackungsexperten, analytischen Tests, Qualitätssicherung, Produktion, externen Partnern, regulatorischen Experten und vielen mehr zusammen. Ziel ist es, innovative Arzneimittelauslieferungssysteme mit Medikamentenformulierung und deren autorenmodernen technischen Dokumentationen für Gesundheitsbehörden und Produktion zu entwickeln und/oder zu integrieren.

Jobbeschreibung Ihre Aufgaben sind unter anderem, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Technische Führung in der funktionsübergreifenden Geräteentwicklung für Autoinjektor und andere Produktentwicklungsprojekte mit Medikamentenkombinationen bieten

• Definieren Sie die Anforderungen und Spezifikationen für die Eingabe von Design-Inputs und die Dokumentation für den Autor, die Überprüfung und die Genehmigung der Design History File (DHF)

• Lead Design Überprüfung und Charakterisierung Aktivitäten, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Anforderungen, Standards und Verwendungszwecke zu demonstrieren

• technische Beiträge zu den Dossiers der Rechtsvorschrift zur Einreichung von Vorschlägen zur Verfügung stellen und die Antworten auf Fragen der Gesundheitsbehörde im Zusammenhang mit der Gerätegestaltung, der Leistung und der Überprüfung unterstützen.

• Durchführung technischer Untersuchungen und Ursachenanalysen, Ermittlung von Korrekturmaßnahmen und Implementierung robuster technischer Lösungen, um ein erneutes Auftreten von Produkt- und Prozessproblemen zu verhindern.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der geltenden Vorschriften, Standards und internen Verfahren

• Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern, Lieferanten, Vertragsherstellern und internen Fertigungsorganisationen, um eine erfolgreiche Geräteentwicklung und Industrialisierung zu gewährleisten.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Dokumentation und Materialien geliefert werden, um klinische Studien, Registrierung und kommerzielle Herstellung zu unterstützen.

• Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher und technischer Beratung für Teammitglieder, Erleichterung des Wissensaustauschs und Beitrag zur Entwicklung bewährter Verfahren im Bereich der technischen Entwicklung.

Rollenanforderungen

• Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Biomedizinischer Technik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

• Bedeutende Erfahrung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre) in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten und/oder Kombinationsprodukten

• Ausgezeichnete mündliche Kommunikation und technische Schreibfähigkeiten in Englisch sind erforderlich

• Nachweis der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams zu beeinflussen und technische Initiativen in einer Matrixumgebung zu leiten.

• Erfahrung in der Konstruktionsprüfung

• Gute Kenntnisse der geltenden Medizinproduktevorschriften und Industriestandards

• Erfahrung mit Lieferanten und CMOs

• Erfahrung mit Design Controls und Design History File (DHF) Dokumentation

• Mindestens 80% vor Ort (4 Tage/Woche)

Engagement für Vielfalt und Inklusion:

Novartis setzt sich für den Aufbau eines herausragenden, inklusiven Arbeitsumfelds und verschiedener Teams ein, die für die Patienten und Gemeinschaften, die wir betreuen, repräsentativ sind.

Rôle Objectif : Chez Novartis, nous repensons la médecine pour améliorer et étendre la vie des gens. Nous découvrons et développons des traitements révolutionnaires et trouvons de nouvelles façons d'apporter des remèdes au plus grand nombre possible. Sans dispositifs de livraison de médicaments sûrs, faciles à utiliser et de haute qualité, nos patients n'ont pas pu obtenir leurs médicaments.

Nous collaborons étroitement avec la gestion de projet, les ingénieurs en facteurs humains, les experts en emballage, les tests analytiques, l'assurance de la qualité, la production, les partenaires externes, les experts en réglementation et bien d'autres encore. L'objectif est de développer et/ou d'intégrer des systèmes de livraison de médicaments innovants avec la formulation de médicaments et la documentation technique de pointe pour les autorités sanitaires et la production.

Description de l'emploi Vos responsabilités comprennent, mais ne se limitent pas :

• Assurer le leadership technique dans les sous-équipes de développement de dispositifs transfonctionnels pour les projets de développement de produits combinés autoinjecteurs et autres médicaments-dispositifs

• Définir les exigences et spécifications de conception, et la documentation de l'auteur, de l'examen et de l'approbation du fichier historique de conception (DHF)

• Activités de vérification et de caractérisation du plomb pour démontrer la conformité aux exigences, aux normes et à l'utilisation prévue applicables

• Fournir des données techniques au dossier de présentation de la réglementation et appuyer les réponses aux questions des autorités sanitaires relatives à la conception, au rendement et aux activités de vérification des appareils.

• Effectuer des enquêtes techniques et des analyses de causes profondes, identifier les mesures correctives et mettre en œuvre des solutions techniques robustes pour prévenir la récurrence des problèmes de produits et de procédés.

• Veiller à ce que les activités de développement soient conformes aux règlements, aux normes et aux procédures internes applicables;

• Collaborer avec des partenaires externes, des fournisseurs, des fabricants contractuels et des organisations de fabrication internes pour assurer le développement et l'industrialisation des appareils.

• Veiller à ce que la documentation et le matériel soient fournis pour appuyer les études cliniques, l'enregistrement et la fabrication commerciale.

• Fournir des conseils scientifiques et techniques aux membres de l'équipe, faciliter le partage des connaissances et contribuer à l'élaboration de pratiques exemplaires en ingénierie.

Exigences relatives au rôle

• Diplôme en génie mécanique, génie biomédical ou discipline connexe

• Expérience significative (habituellement 10 ans et plus) dans le développement d'instruments médicaux et/ou de produits combinés

• Excellente communication verbale et compétences techniques en écriture en anglais sont nécessaires

• Capacité démontrée d'influencer les équipes interfonctionnelles et de diriger les initiatives techniques dans un environnement matriciel.

• Expérience en matière de vérification de la conception

• Bonne connaissance des règlements applicables en matière de matériels médicaux et des normes de l'industrie

• Expérience de travail avec les fournisseurs et les OCM

• Expérience avec la documentation de contrôle de conception et de dossier historique de conception (DHF)

• Au moins 80% sur le chantier (4 jours/semaine)

Novartis s'engage à créer un milieu de travail exceptionnel et inclusif et des équipes variées représentatives des patients et des collectivités que nous servons.

À Novartis, nous sommes déterminés à rejuger la médecine ensemble - et à récompenser les gens qui la rendent possible.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Are you ready to help shape how a leading global healthcare company partners, innovates, and delivers impact? As Legal Counsel Global Procurement, DD&IT, you will play a critical role in enabling strategic business decisions, advising on high-value commercial transactions, and helping teams navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of law, technology, procurement, and innovation while collaborating with stakeholders across the globe. Your primary focus will be supporting global Procurement activities, particularly indirect procurement, while partnering with DD&IT stakeholders on technology-related matters where required.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Partner with global Procurement teams as a trusted legal advisor on strategic sourcing initiatives.

• Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial agreements for goods and services including technology, SaaS, AI and other digital solutions where required.

• Provide practical, risk-based legal guidance on commercial, operational, and governance matters.

• Support global projects and transactions while balancing legal risks with business objectives working independently and in collaboration with legal colleagues across jurisdictions.

• Deliver legal training and awareness sessions to Procurement and digital stakeholders.

• Identify, assess, and manage legal risks across procurement activities and technology-related projects . Assist in the management of disputes, dispute resolution matters and external counsel where appropriate.

• Collaborate across legal, compliance, and business teams to drive successful outcomes including supporting colleagues on cross-border matters requiring Swiss law expertise.

• Contribute to innovation, continuous improvement, and adoption of new legal technologies.

Essential Requirements

• Qualified Swiss lawyer with admission to the Swiss Bar.

• Post-qualification legal experience in a leading law firm or in an in-house role

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts combined with a pragmatic, and strong solution-oriented approach .

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Proven ability to provide practical, solution-focused legal advice in complex business environments.

• Experience advising on topics like SaaS, IT and artificial intelligence

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 126.000 - 234.000 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
